name: checksum
description: A minimal, evidence-driven development workflow: design, plan, execute, finish. Upfront design and fresh verification carry the quality load; testing policy is spec-anchored by default and configurable per project.

interface.shortDescription: Design, plan, execute, finish - with evidence, not ritual.
interface.longDescription: A minimal development workflow for coding agents. Design and plan before code, execute against spec-anchored acceptance checks, and finish only with fresh verification evidence. Configurable per project through a plain-markdown preferences file.
defaultPrompt: Use checksum to design and build a new feature.
Resume the checksum plan in this repo.
